items.description:
US President Donald Trump replaced chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller on Friday, elevating the architect of some of his toughest domestic policies to run the White House after Republicans lost control of Congress in this week’s midterm elections.
The shake-up puts a longtime Trump loyalist and firebrand policy adviser in charge of steering Trump’s agenda as the president prepares to confront a Democratic-led House of Representatives and Senate, and an expected wave of congressional investigations.

items.description:
The National Cyber Emergency Response Team (NCERT) has warned of an increased use of artificial intelligence (AI) and automated bots to carry out credential-based and coordinated cyberattacks, noting that critical infrastructure and financial services are at particular risk.
